item.title: Cobot Welding System Boosts Output
item.description: Now, the cobot can weld one component while the operator replaces the completed part, minimizing downtime and maximizing output. By using one robot across multiple stations, PeyMar made the most of its limited floor space. It also reduced costs for labor, capital investment and maintenance.

item.title: Lanco Awarded Contract to Develop Automated Test System for Medical Device Manufacturer
item.description: WESTBROOK, ME—Systems integrator Lanco has been awarded a contract to design and build an automated, pallet-based test system for high-volume production of a medical device.

item.title: Rare Earth Shortages Squeeze Aerospace, Semiconductor Supply Chains
item.description: WASHINGTON – Suppliers to U.S. aerospace and semiconductor manufacturers are facing tightening supplies of key rare earth materials.

item.title: Uber to Deploy Fleet of Rivian R2 Robotaxis
item.description: SAN FRANCISCO—Uber has formed a strategic partnership with Rivian aimed at accelerating both companies’ autonomous vehicle plans.

item.title: IKEA Automates Adhesive Dispensing
item.description: IKEA turned to automated woodworking equipment company Lehbrink and automated dispensing technology company Robatech to automate adhesive application for its Pax 2.0 wardrobe.

item.title: GE Aerospace Targets Increased Engine Output With €110 Million European Investment
item.description: BRUSSELS — GE Aerospace plans to invest more than €110 million across its European manufacturing sites this year to expand production capacity, scale advanced manufacturing and support engine delivery across commercial and defense programs.

item.title: Survey Highlights “Discovery Gap” in Manufacturing Workforce as Satisfaction Reaches Record Levels
item.description: NASHVILLE, Tenn. – A new manufacturing workforce study shows employees are highly satisfied and optimistic about the industry — but most did not plan to enter it, highlighting a growing “discovery gap” that continues to limit the talent pipeline.

item.title: Blake Maurer on AI Inspection, Structured Data and Modern Quality Management
item.description: Blake Maurer of Loopr AI discusses how manufacturers can improve quality inspection by combining human expertise with AI-enabled visual inspection systems.

item.title: New Process Secures Sheet Metal Assemblies
item.description: A new sheet-metal joining process developed by Tox Pressotechnik reliably secures sheet metal components and prevents displacement in the planar direction.

item.title: Measuring What Matters: An Engineer’s Guide to Manufacturing KPIs
item.description: For engineers and operations managers seeking to improve production performance, selecting the right throughput metrics is critical. This article outlines practical measurement approaches to help monitor, diagnose and improve your manufacturing operations.
